item.title: High school bowling: Kingston’s Vincent rolls perfect game in sweep of Port Jervis
item.description: PORT JERVIS, N.Y. — Kingston High’s Hunter Vincent rolled a 300 game to highlight a sweep of Port Jervis in a boys and girls bowling match at Memory Lanes on Thursday, Feb. 12. Vincent added games of 234 and 178 to finish with a 712 series as the Tigers’ boys team beat Port Jervis 3,089-2,749. […]
